subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `PluginHookAgentContext` permanently expose a deferred, current-session-only `resetSession(reason?)` capability for successful `after_compaction` hooks?
rationale: This is a new plugin API and session-lifecycle capability; tests can validate mechanics, but only maintainers can establish whether this belongs in the supported plugin contract and what compatibility guarantees it receives.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow contract
options.body: Approve the after-compaction-only API, require the leaf-module repair, public contract documentation, focused contract tests, and completed live lifecycle proof before merge.

options.title: Keep reset owner-internal
options.body: Do not expose reset through plugin hooks and instead add an owner-specific internal recovery seam for the motivating context-engine integration.

options.title: Pause for broader lifecycle design
options.body: Hold this PR until reset, compaction, and post-run maintenance capabilities are designed together as a broader plugin session-lifecycle API.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Approve the after-compaction-only API, require the leaf-module repair, public contract documentation, focused contract tests, and completed live lifecycle proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history connects this person to both context-engine compaction sequencing and the current compaction-hook lifecycle contract.
